                    degree_id = $2,
                    education_program = $3,
                    faculty = $4,
                    speciality_code = $5,
                    type_id = $6,
                    master_type = $7,
                    study_form_id = $8,
                    license_volume = $9,
                    budgetary_places = $10
                WHERE id = $11
